setup_sequence: Under the conditional consolidated setup grant: same broker elevated PowerShell 7 creates only fresh disabled fixed accounts, actual CreateProfile roots and new finite protected C: tree; original intent and SID receipts precede later changes. No existing account/root adoption. A retained empty private setup.lock is created only with the fresh root; all later mutation modes open the owned original exclusively and refuse collision/missing lock. GET readback never creates a lock and reports active/missing as HOLD, including actual bounded ProfileList path on partial profile creation.

Ordinary broker PowerShell 7 prompts again using SecureString and stores only the two fixed local-machine-persistent Credential Manager targets in that broker user store; exact bytes read back, no password argv/environment/receipt or secret IPC. Accounts remain disabled. This does not prove the entered password can log on; the existing bounded inert capability test is still mandatory after enable.

Complete independent C: source/tool/config/credential/capture ancestry, task/service/WSL/source readbacks and installed descriptor pins. Tasks remain disabled. Root is initially empty; setup does not clone or copy source automatically.

Only after all setup readbacks: same broker elevated enable with exact created.json and credentials-complete.json SHA256 values. Then ordinary readback and mandatory bounded inert account capability test, followed by final task enable/readback. One ordinary broker desktop session is required; no per-attempt target sign-in.

After ambiguity/failure: no automatic replay. A CreateNew disable intent precedes any exact recorded-SID mutation, Enabled=false is read back, and an existing intent permits GET-only reconciliation rather than replay. Disabling an account does not terminate existing processes or establish owned-group closure; existing recovery remains mandatory before any later candidate or credential release. Keep profiles, credentials, files and partial records. No ACL restoration without positive no-use plus current exact postimage equality; this entry performs no ACL restoration or deletion.
